pitch_routes.route: Apple's policy is that it does not accept, review or consider unsolicited ideas, including content or creative materials, and anything sent becomes Apple's property. Approach through an established production company or agent.

briefs.title: Apple TV moves against broader streaming, with just 18% unscripted content
briefs.summary: Ampere Analysis: Apple TV is the only major streamer that grew its scripted share between Q2 2022 and Q2 2026. Unscripted is 18% of US catalogue hours, the lowest among major platforms. The focus is premium scripted drama, so unscripted and documentary is a narrow market.

commissioners.name: Alison Kirkham
commissioners.title: Commissioning - Unscripted, Apple TV
commissioners.remit: Develops and oversees original unscripted series for Apple TV in the UK and European creative team (hired 2020 as Head of Unscripted, Europe)
commissioners.pitch_route: No unsolicited pitches; approach via a production company or agent
commissioners.notes: Current role confirmed by the RTS trustee appointment report (30 Jan 2026). Former BBC Controller of Factual Commissioning. In 2020-21 she reported to Jay Hunt (Creative Director, Europe); the current reporting line is not confirmed. No Apple commission found credited to her by name.
